other_failure_modes.name: Reporting score on tuning data
other_failure_modes.description: The agent reports its final validation score using the exact same validation set that was used to tune the ensemble weights and select the best models for retraining. This causes the reported final score to be overly optimistic due to leakage of the validation distribution into the ensembling logic.

summary: The agent provides a strong solution with extensive feature engineering, a diverse ensemble, and a valid retraining strategy on the full data. However, it fails to implement explicit data cleaning routines, evaluates its stochastic setup on only a single data split, and reports its final score on the same validation set used to tune the ensemble weights.
